## About
City Auto Parts runs as City Auto Recycling on Aldine Mail Rte Rd in north Houston. We're serving the Houston, TX area with quality used parts.
You can search our inventory online, search by image, or look up a few parts at once with multi-part search. Buscar Autopartes is on our site too.
We hold a 4.1 rating from 23 Google reviews. Call before you head over so we can check on the part you need.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used auto parts for drivers across the Houston area.
- Search Inventory: Look through our parts online before you come in. You can also search by image or use multi-part search.
- Buscar Autopartes: Buscar Autopartes is available on our site.
